en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a river with a metal truss bridge and riverbank promenade. Behind the bridge stands a row of multi‑story historic buildings and a church tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock. On the hillside above the town are fortification walls and buildings, and to the right a prominent clock tower on the hill. Printed title text appears along the upper edge, and a commercial building bears painted signage.
